Surveyed inventory and operating status of pipes, wells, buildings, services and plant; pilot outlines do not provide these.
Surveyed corridor, ownership/easements, road condition, intersections, traffic and delivery feasibility.
Field channel survey, upstream catchment, design storm/discharge, return periods and verified restrictions.
Survey control, detailed levels, soils, bearing, infiltration and seismic design evidence.
